facts.fact: Connecting Africa reports Djibouti Telecom announced plans to extend DARE1 (Djibouti, Somalia, Kenya, in service since 2021) by 3,200-3,500 km from Mombasa to Mtunzini, South Africa, with branches planned for Tanzania, Mozambique and Madagascar, work expected from 2026 and ready for service in 2028; no signed agreement is described.

note: as_of is the announcement 'late last week' before the 1 September 2025 publication, approximated to 29 August 2025.
